decision.question: Which delegation/ownership/budget/provenance/knowledge-promotion semantics are absent or insufficiently normative in current MCP/A2A surfaces, and what versioned adapter contract preserves canonical AgentOS hub envelope provider-neutral without changing authorization meaning?
decision.answer: Three semantics are ABSENT/UNDERSPECIFIED in both MCP 2026-07-28 and A2A 1.0.0: (1) exact-action delegation grants and child scope (SM6), (2) budget reservation/consumption/aggregation (SM8), and (3) knowledge promotion/challenge/rejection/revocation (SM11). The remaining 12 of 15 capability rows are supported via lossless or lossy-safe mappings. The versioned adapter contract (contract_version 1.0) preserves the canonical AgentOS hub envelope provider-neutral by enforcing 8 hard rules: protocol payload is never authority; untrusted-until-verified; adapter narrows only; lossy auth field -> DENY; unknown ext -> quarantine; cancel != reconcile-cancel; knowledge proposal-only until governance event; budget conservation invariant.
decision.limitation: Producer and verifier labels are process-separated roles in one local environment, not external human auditors. No full third-party content archiving.
decision.migration_trigger: New research revision required for any MCP/A2A version change, new capability surface, or security finding. Rollback: revert adapter_version, frozen corpus remains valid.
decision.non_goals: No production MCP/A2A server/client or vendor SDK rollout. No modification of MCP/A2A standards. No production identity federation, PKI, networking, or SLO. No Goal acceptance by worker/model.

limitations: Boundary measurements are same-host and process-separated, not external human auditors.
Verdict is PASS_WITH_LIMITS: requires external auditor (S1-019) and full third-party content archiving (S1-018) for full PASS.
Budget (SM8), delegation grants (SM6), and knowledge promotion (SM11) are ABSENT in both MCP 2026-07-28 and A2A 1.0.0; adapter correctly deny-by-default and documents these as gaps.
Knowledge governance event model deferred to S1-011; S1-009 correctly keeps knowledge at proposal-only.
MCP streaming and A2A push/async bindings are partially modeled; full binding coverage is a follow-up.
note: research-plan PASS_WITH_LIMITS is a research evaluation; it never sets Goal ACCEPTED (release gate only). All IDs and hashes extracted from canonical DB rows; no manual input.
